newsitem.title: USA: Conbraco to build $22 mln plant in S.C..
newsitem.headline: Conbraco to build $22 mln plant in S.C..

text.p: Conbraco Industries Inc said Wednesday it will hold ground breaking ceremonies on May 2 in Pageland, S.C. for a new $22 million, 200,000 square-foot foundry and manufacturing facility.
The company said the new plant should be completed in early 1998 and will generate as many as 325 new jobs during its first five years of operation.

It is the largest and most costly expansion in company history, said Conbraco, and will be the ninth expansion at its Pageland facility since it was established in 1970. The plant is home to the company's line of Apollo bronze ball valves.

Conbraco currently operates four manufacturing facilities in North and South Carolina employing more than 1,500 people. Like all Conbraco plants, the new plant is expected to be registered to strict ISO 9001 quality standards.
